rationale: The #2853 vocabulary probe compares two 2,000-step from-scratch arms that differ only in their vocabulary: C4 (one piece per digit, published) and C6 (C4 plus every punctuation and symbol character as a single-character piece, candidate). The question is relative, so the probe registers no absolute minimum. C6 must leave no gold edge at a character-class change inside a piece, and must lose at most one point of exact parse against C4 on two populations: register rows that carry house numbers and postcodes, and rows that carry venue names, whose punctuation (`S.A.`, `@cosme`, `B.indulged`) C6 now splits into pieces of its own.

requirements.task: Reading the house number and postcode of a register address exactly, alongside the rest of the row
requirements.reason: Isolating punctuation changes how a hyphenated or prefixed postcode (`HR-23211`, `59-916`) and a house-number range reach the model, and these sources hold most of the held-out house numbers and postcodes.
requirements.maxLossReason: One point of exact parse is the smallest loss the probe treats as a vocabulary defect rather than seed noise, as in probe-split-digits-1.

requirements.task: Reading an address that leads with a venue or organization name exactly
requirements.reason: Venue and organization names carry punctuation that belongs to the name (`EMPRENDIMIENTOS FLUVIALES S.A.`), and C6 splits each mark into its own piece.
requirements.maxLossReason: One point of exact parse, as for the house-number and postcode check.

inference.description: HELDOUT_INFERENCE_RULE in heldout/per/country.ts (served-locale-package): each row is parsed by the shipped Latin locale package for its country (release.config.json locales), falling back to en-us, with the row's country as localeHint; a package whose loader reports an unfed required channel is refused. The verdict records the rule and the rows each package parsed.

statistics.groupingAssumption: A row's independent unit is its group within its country: base_source_id when derived, else source_id. Rows are not declared independent, so a check that reads an ungrouped row is insufficient evidence. Limitation: structure shared across groups (one source's conventions, one place's many addresses) is not modelled. The dataset quota counts groups, not rows, against 1,000 per country.

development.description: Unregistered: freeze heldout-<corpus>-dev with one seed; used for recipe, checkpoint and seed selection.

confirmation.description: Unregistered: freeze heldout-<corpus>-confirm with a disjoint seed; read only for the release decision, every read recorded in the next spec version's rationale.

vocabulary.reason: A gold edge at a character-class change that falls inside a piece is outside every output the model can produce, so the limit is zero rather than a fitted value.
